the regulation of the immune system.
the study of the regulation of basophils by the cytokines IL-3 and granulo-cyte-macrophage (GM) CSF.
the regulation of basophils in vitro by the human T cell-derived lymphokines IL-3 and granuloctye-macrophage CSF.

the basophil is a target for both IL-3 and granulo-cyte-macrophage CSF.
basophil function is modulated by cytokines, and that these cytokines act through specific cell surface receptors to exert their biological effects.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the basophils have a receptor for GM-CSF.
the basophil is a target cell for IL-3, GM-CSF and IFN-gamma.

The main takeaway from our work is that
basophils are capable of binding IL-3 and granulo-macrophage-colony-stimulating factor.
human basophils express high-affinity receptors that are capable of binding IL-3 and that the binding of IL-3 to these receptors is inhibited competitively by GM-CSF.
basophils have receptors for both IL-3 and for GM-CSF, which suggests that these cytokines may be involved in the regulation of human basophil development and/or function.
